title: 第570章 选择硬刚第569章 等不及了符瑶远嫁2

content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：凡人修仙，捡个仙子做老婆第一卷：默认第570章选择硬刚（..la）五天后。
项家明堂。
项天霖终于等到了姗姗来迟的王家代表。
不是之前带着王不惑来过的那位王乾夜，而是换了王家头号战将——王明朗！
“天霖啊，几年不见了，清瘦了。”
王明朗身形魁梧，眉眼锋锐，他走到项天霖面前，淡淡看了一眼，没等他客套，便擦身而过，走进了明堂。
项天霖知道这位王家头号战将性格强势霸道，也不计较，带着长老们跟在后面走了进去。可刚要示意王明朗落座，却见王明朗自顾自的，走到了主座位置，轻甩衣袍，转身坐了下去。
项家诸位长老，纷纷面露怒容。
这里是项家！
分不清主客了吗？
“都别站着了，坐吧。”
王明朗随意的抬了抬手，示意他们两侧落座。
那姿态好像他才是这里的主人。
长老们纷纷看向家主，却见项天霖默默地坐到了旁边客座。
忍了？？
为了那九毒菇子吗？
其他长老碰了碰目光，咬着牙分散落座。
王明朗心里冷哼。
本就是王家养的狗，竟然妄想挣脱锁链？
真是不知死活。

“说吧，请我过来，是为何事啊？”
王明朗抬手，敲了敲身旁茶桌，淡淡开口。
项天霖深深吸气，轻缓呼出，刚要开口，却听前面一声爆响。
王明朗抬手重重拍打桌案，斥责站在旁边的侍女：“你是瞎了，还是聋了？看茶不会吗？”
“啊？是是……”
那侍女心头一颤，慌忙上前。
“滚！！”
王明朗突然暴起一掌，结结实实按在那侍女胸口。
侍女通体狂颤，直接飞了出去明堂，落地后连连翻滚十几圈，当场就没了动静。
胸骨尽碎。
内脏化作血水。
“你干什么？？”
有长老忍无可忍，暴怒而起。
“奴才就该有个奴才的样，做不好，就该收拾！”
王明朗冷冷瞥了眼那位长老，指尖泛起道道黑鳞，轻敲桌面：“看茶！”

Xiangjia Mingtang.
Xiang Tianlin finally waited for the belated representative of the Wang family.
It's not Wang Qianye who brought Wang Buhuo here before, but the Wang family's number one general - Wang Minglang!
"Tianlin, I haven't seen him for a few years and he has become thinner."
Wang Minglang was a tall man with sharp features. He walked up to Xiang Tianlin, glanced at him briefly, and walked past Xiang Tianlin before he could be polite.
Xiang Tianlin knew that the Wang family's number one general had a strong and domineering personality, so he didn't care and walked in with the elders following him. But just as he was about to signal Wang Minglang to sit down, he saw Wang Minglang was minding his own business, walked to the main seat, flicked his robe, turned around and sat down.
The elders of the Xiang family all showed angry faces.
This is the Xiang family!
Can't tell the difference between host and guest?
"Stop standing, sit down."
Wang Minglang raised his hand casually and motioned for them to sit down on both sides.
His posture seemed to be that he was the master here.
The elders all looked at the head of the family, only to see Xiang Tianlin silently sitting next to him as a guest.
Can you bear it? ?
For those nine poisonous mushrooms?
The other elders looked at each other, gritted their teeth and sat down separately.
Wang Mingliang snorted in his heart.
This is a dog raised by the Wang family, but it actually wants to break free from its chains?
Really desperate.
"Tell me, why did you invite me over?"
Wang Minglang raised his hand, knocked on the tea table next to him, and spoke calmly.
Xiang Tianlin took a deep breath and exhaled slowly. Just as he was about to speak, he heard an explosion in front of him.
Wang Minglang raised his hand and slapped the table hard, scolding the maid standing next to him: "Are you blind or deaf? Can't you make tea?"
"Ah? Yes..."
The maid's heart trembled and she hurriedly stepped forward.
"Get out!!"
Wang Minglang suddenly raised a palm and pressed it firmly on the maid's chest.
The maid trembled wildly and flew directly out of the Mingtang. After landing, she rolled dozens of times and became silent on the spot.
The sternum was completely shattered.
The internal organs turned into blood.
"What are you doing??"
Some elders couldn't bear it anymore and got angry.
"A slave should behave like a slave. If he doesn't do well, he should be punished!"
Wang Minglang glanced at the elder coldly, black scales appeared on his fingertips, and tapped the table: "Watch the tea!"
